parts.text: The red light produced by a laser is monochromatic.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The red light from the laser hits the curved surface of a semicircular transparent plastic block at point P and passes into the plastic. The red light travels through the plastic and hits the straight edge of the block at its midpoint M. Fig. 6.1 shows that some of the light is reflected and that some light travels in the air along the straight edge of the plastic block. Fig. 6.1 The speed of light in air is 3.0 × 10 8 m / s.
